results.title: Israel is building more military posts in Gaza, satellite imagery shows — Al Jazeera Open Source Unit
results.snippet: Al Jazeera Open Source Unit analysis of PlanetScope and WorldView satellite imagery identifies 40 distinct military outposts in Gaza. 8 built from scratch after Oct 2025 ceasefire. One outpost built atop Eastern Cemetery in Khan Younis. 70% expansion of outpost east of Gaza City. Military infrastructure consolidation ongoing.

results.title: Tropical Storm Jangmi makes landfall in Japan at Wakayama, 23 injured, 57 houses damaged
results.snippet: Jangmi made landfall near Wakayama at 4:30am local June 3. 23 injured, 57 houses damaged, 900 flights canceled. Tokyo issued first-ever Level 4 danger alert. Mie Prefecture received month's worth of rain in 1 day. Kawasaki flooding 30cm.

results.title: WMO: Prepare for El Nino — 80% probability June-August, 90%+ November 2026
results.snippet: WMO official statement: 80% probability of El Nino conditions June-August 2026. 90%+ by November. 2026 Atlantic hurricane season opened June 1 with zero activity — El Nino suppression effect. Dry air dominating.

results.title: China building massive nuclear launch pads near missile silos, satellite images show — NBC/Reuters
